atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for USDJPY (SCALPING). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=3.453, trend_persistence=0.27, mean_reversion=0.73. Ablation-retained features: liquidity_sweep (w=+0.471), ema_trend (w=+0.170), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.158), bos_breakout (w=+0.106) (pruned/left out by ablation: sentinel_news_sentiment).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for USDJPY (SCALPING): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=3.453, mean-reversion=0.73). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to M5 (w=+0.267), M15 (w=+0.217), H1 (w=+0.193). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [liquidity_sweep (w=+0.471), ema_trend (w=+0.170), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.158), bos_breakout (w=+0.106)] and pruned [sentinel_news_sentiment].
